packages/kernel/SBOM.cdx.json.note: the kernel's own CycloneDX SBOM lists exactly these four packages as required, with the same SHA-512

taken: Each tarball was read from the local npm cache (~/.npm/_cacache/content-v2/sha512/..., content-addressed by the same sha512 the lockfile records), its sha512 re-computed and compared with the def297f package-lock.json integrity, then extracted with `tar -xzf <tgz> --strip-components 1 -C deps/<name>@<version>`. Every file below is a tar member byte for byte (compared member by member); nothing was added, removed or rewritten. No network, nothing installed.

packages.name: @noble/curves
packages.role: ed25519 (the classical half of the hybrid authorization); `@noble/curves/utils.js` and `abstract/fft.js` for ML-DSA

packages.name: @noble/hashes
packages.role: sha256 and the byte helpers the kernel imports; sha512 for ed25519; shake128/256 for ML-DSA

packages.name: @noble/post-quantum
packages.role: ML-DSA-65 (the post-quantum half of the hybrid authorization)

packages.name: @noble/ciphers
packages.role: NOT on the kernel import path: a declared dependency of @noble/post-quantum 0.6.1, pinned 2.2.0 by the same lockfile and listed as a required component in the kernel SBOM, carried so the pinned set is complete

resolutionLinks.why: Node resolves the bare `@noble/curves/...` specifiers inside the untouched packages here (deps/node_modules is the nearest one); it realpaths to @noble/curves@2.2.0
Node resolves the bare `@noble/hashes/...` specifiers inside the untouched packages here (deps/node_modules is the nearest one); it realpaths to @noble/hashes@2.2.0
Node resolves the bare `@noble/post-quantum/...` specifiers inside the untouched packages here (deps/node_modules is the nearest one); it realpaths to @noble/post-quantum@0.6.1
Node resolves the bare `@noble/ciphers/...` specifiers inside the untouched packages here (deps/node_modules is the nearest one); it realpaths to @noble/ciphers@2.2.0

kernelImportClosure.note: The modules node loads for the four @noble specifiers the kernel imports (static ESM graph). Everything else in the packages is carried, not executed.
